description: An outside agent is given a task that needs the team's own knowledge. Each task runs twice: once with the context Beakr's session hooks inject at start, once without it (the agent can still look Knowledge up through its Beakr tools). The bar: higher task success and fewer Knowledge lookups with context.

cases.title: Write a wash-step config using the lab's standard buffer

setup.title: ELISA wash protocol
setup.summary: How the Halden lab washes ELISA plates.

sections.title: Standard
sections.body: Every ELISA in the Halden lab washes plates with PBS-T (PBS with 0.05% Tween-20), four washes of 300 uL per well between each step.

task.prompt: I'm setting up the plate washer for tomorrow's ELISA. Write the wash step as a short YAML block (buffer, washes, volume_ul) using our lab's standard.

cases.title: Schedule a release around the team's deploy freeze

sections.title: Freeze
sections.body: The platform team does not deploy to production from Thursday 16:00 to Monday 09:00 (Europe/Oslo). Releases go out Tuesday or Wednesday mornings after the 10:00 stand-up.

task.prompt: Draft a one-paragraph plan for when to ship the billing-service release this week, following our team's deploy rules.

cases.title: Route a failing assay to the person who owns it

setup.title: Assay ownership
setup.summary: Who owns which assay at Norrvik Bio.

sections.title: Owners
sections.body: The KX2 binding assay is owned by Ines Okafor; escalations go to her first, then to the assay-dev channel. The solubility panel is owned by Tomas Reyes.

task.prompt: The KX2 binding assay failed QC twice today. Write the escalation message I should send, addressed to the right owner.

cases.title: Name a new compound batch by the team's convention

sections.title: Format
sections.body: Compound batches are named <compound>-B<two-digit batch number>-<YYMMDD of synthesis>, for example BK-7-B03-260412. Batch numbers restart per compound.

task.prompt: We synthesized the fourth batch of BK-7 on 2026-05-02. What should the batch be named under our convention? Give just the name and one line of reasoning.

cases.title: Use a corrected QC threshold, not the stale one
cases.notes: Scoring changed 2026-10-10 (scorer 2026-10-10.2): the stale threshold is forbidden in the delivered code (code_must_not_include), not anywhere in the answer. The task asks for a Python condition, so the code is the deliverable; under the old literal check an answer whose code used 0.5 failed for warning against the old 0.4 in prose. Earlier reports keep their original scores; rescored copies are labelled (beakr_bench.rescore). Scoring changed again 2026-10-10 (scorer 2026-10-10.3, audit C066): the delivered code must state the inclusive lower bound z_prime >= 0.5 (either operand order) and must not state z_prime >= 0.4; containing the string 0.5 is no longer enough, since z_prime > 0.5 and z_prime <= 0.5 are wrong.

setup.title: Plate QC thresholds
setup.summary: QC acceptance thresholds for screening plates.

sections.title: Z-prime
sections.body: A screening plate passes QC when its Z-prime is at least 0.4.

setup.title: Plate QC thresholds
setup.reason: The screening committee raised the bar after the March false-positive review.

sections.title: Z-prime
sections.body: A screening plate passes QC when its Z-prime is at least 0.5 (raised from 0.4 by the screening committee in April 2026).

task.prompt: Write the QC check for our screening plates as a single Python condition on a variable named z_prime, using our current threshold.

cases.title: Find where a reagent is stored before writing a pick list

sections.title: Freezers
sections.body: Recombinant KX2 protein is stored in freezer F-3, rack 2, at -80 C. Detection antibodies are in fridge R-1.

task.prompt: Write a two-item pick list for tomorrow's binding run: recombinant KX2 protein and the detection antibody, with where each is stored.
